note: Everyday device-control commands the model emits as STRUCTURED calls (no screen/vision). Covers the common things a person does by hand: settings toggles, display/audio/power, alarms/timers, focus, apps, media, plus user-app actions. The device is treated as idealized/permissive for evaluation; per-OS permission gating is a later concern. sensitivity: safe|confirm|blocked marks genuinely disruptive/outbound actions.
